# LOG_INGEST

Where logs are pushed and queried.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `logs`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.logs`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
